name: Iron Boulder
description: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.

moves.name: Horn Attack
moves.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

moves.name: Sacred Sword
moves.description: The user attacks by slicing with a sword. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.

moves.name: Mighty Cleave
moves.description: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

moves.name: Quick Guard
moves.description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

moves.name: Meteor Beam
moves.description: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
